notes: call_type convention (SPEC names the six call_types but does not define direct vs method): a call with no written receiver is direct; a call with a written receiver (obj., this., super., a type name) is method; new/super(...)/this(...) are constructor. Files with no package declaration are in the unnamed package, so there is no qualifier: `Main#main`, not `src.Main#main` or a path-derived prefix (the qualifier comes from the package declaration, not the directory).
